value.statement: Within 5 minutes of placing the order, the customer can cancel and get a full refund.

After 5 minutes, some amount will be charged and the remaining amount will be refunded, depending on elapsed time and preparation status. There is no verified fixed percentage or fixed cancellation fee.

name: Exact Cancellation Fee
statement: There is NO verified fixed percentage or fixed cancellation fee. Exact refund calculation depends on elapsed time and preparation status.
